// Check the errors of uvm_hdl_read and uvm_hdl_deposit when the object
// found in the design does not have the value type of the access.

#include <systemc>
#include <uvm>

#include "reg.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace uvm;
using namespace sc_core;
using namespace sc_dt;

class dut_t : public sc_module
{
public:
  sc_signal<sc_uint<16>, SC_MANY_WRITERS> w16;
  sc_signal<sc_uint<8> > w8_one_writer;
  reg<sc_uint<16> > q16;
  sc_vector<reg<sc_uint<16> > > v16;

  dut_t(sc_module_name nm)
  : sc_module(nm),
  w16("w16"),
  w8_one_writer("w8_one_writer"),
  q16("q16"),
  v16("v16", 2)
  {}
}; // class dut_t


class test : public uvm_test
{
 public:
  UVM_COMPONENT_UTILS(test);

  int failures;

  test( uvm_component_name name ) : uvm_test(name), failures(0)
  {}

  void expect_false( bool ok, const std::string& what )
  {
    if (ok)
    {
      cout << "unexpected success: " << what << endl;
      failures++;
    }
  }

  void run_phase( uvm_phase& phase )
  {
    phase.raise_objection(this);

    sc_uint<8> v8 = 0x5A;
    uvm_reg_data_t rd = 0;

    // uvm_sc_if of another type
    expect_false(uvm_hdl_read("dut.q16", v8), "read dut.q16");
    expect_false(uvm_hdl_deposit("dut.q16", v8), "deposit dut.q16");

    // sc_signal of another type
    expect_false(uvm_hdl_read("dut.w16", v8), "read dut.w16");
    expect_false(uvm_hdl_deposit("dut.w16", v8), "deposit dut.w16");

    // sc_signal with the right type, but not SC_MANY_WRITERS
    expect_false(uvm_hdl_read("dut.w8_one_writer", v8), "read dut.w8_one_writer");

    // sc_vector of uvm_sc_if of another type
    expect_false(uvm_hdl_read("dut.v16[1]", v8), "read dut.v16[1]");
    expect_false(uvm_hdl_deposit("dut.v16[1]", v8), "deposit dut.v16[1]");

    // register backdoor type
    expect_false(uvm_hdl_read("dut.q16", rd), "read dut.q16 as uvm_reg_data_t");

    // all errors of uvm_hdl_read use HDL_READ
    expect_false(uvm_hdl_read("dut.v16[2]", v8), "read dut.v16[2]");
    expect_false(uvm_hdl_read("$root.dut.nonexistent", v8), "read dut.nonexistent");

    phase.drop_objection(this);
  }

  void report_phase( uvm_phase& phase )
  {
    uvm_report_server* svr = uvm_report_server::get_server();

    if (failures == 0 &&
        svr->get_severity_count(UVM_FATAL) == 0 &&
        svr->get_severity_count(UVM_ERROR) == 10 &&
        svr->get_id_count("HDL_READ") == 7 &&
        svr->get_id_count("HDL_DEPOSIT") == 3)
      cout << "** UVM TEST PASSED **" << endl;
    else
      cout << "!! UVM TEST FAILED !!" << endl;
  }
};

int sc_main(int, char*[])
{
  test test1("test1");

  dut_t dut("dut");

  run_test();

  return 0;
}
